test_title: PYST 24: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 3 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underline segment in the given sentence.

Some politicians __turn up their face __at the hard life of downtrodden people.
solution:
The correct answer is "**turn up their nose**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Turn their face**" means to **change their personality from a villain to a hero**. 

 
 
• **Example:** *Ron **turned his face** to get the job. *
 
 
 
• "**Turn up their nose**" means **refuse something because it is not good for you.** 
 
 
• **Example**: *Annie **turned up her nose **when she was asked to take engineering. *
 
 
 
• Therefore, the appropriate option that would substitute "turn up their face" is "turn up their nose". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's see some idioms beginning with "**turn**".

 
 

 **Idiom**
 **Meaning**
 **Example**
 
 

 **Turn the tables**
 to reverse the position making a disadvantage into an advantage.
 *The peon **turned the tables** when he caught the official taking bribes.* 
 
 

 **Turn to jelly**
 feeling weak because of nervousness.
 *Harry **turned to jelly** when he was asked to address the school assembly.*
 
 

 **Turn up**
 arrive
 *Tim **turned up** for the interview at the right time. *
